correctness.rationale: For A=P T_Λ, the frame operator is AA*=P S_Λ P and the minimal-norm right inverse is A*(AA*)^{-1}=T_Λ* P (P S_Λ P)^{-1}. All bounded right inverses differ by an operator with image in ker A. Coordinates therefore give Γ_j=Λ_j P S_{PΛP}^{-1}+T_j, A T=0. The published term Λ_j S_{PΛP}^{-1}P reconstructs P S_Λ P^{-1}S_Λ^{-1}, equal to I iff [P,S_Λ]=0. In the exact two-dimensional witness S_Λ=diag(1,2), P=[[2,1],[1,2]], this reconstruction is [[2/3,1/3],[-2/3,7/6]], not I. P has eigenvalues 1 and 3. This proves general equivalence and a valid counterexample, not merely numerics.
